newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares edge higher, focus on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares edge higher, focus on blue chips.

text.p: Share prices opened marginally higher on Tuesday but brokers were divided about which path the market would take.
At 0825 GMT the general index was up 0.24 percent to 3,121.44 and turnover volumes continued to be small.
Brokers said the focus would be on blue chips.
Players were waiting for Ericsson rival Motorola's first half result expected after the U.S. market closes on Tuesday.
"I think people will leave Ericsson alone today," one broker told Reuters.
But another broker said: "I am not expecting a big reaction by Ericsson after the Motorola report. They have been going separate ways lately."
Drug company Astra furthered Monday's gains, rising two crowns to 158.
